notes:
Name example parts in the player's language

Probes and pots in the examples were called Netz, Last, Licht even in
English. Example files now carry English names for them ("labels"),
used when the game runs in English. The generator keeps those names and
gives the computer example's chips their pinmap, so regenerating no
longer drops it; it also writes the default parameters parts have now.
